children: Retail sales in Thailand dropped by 18.3% year-on-year in June 2026, little changed from an upwardly revised 18.2% decrease in the previous month.

This marked the third consecutive month of decline in retail activity, largely driven by lower sales in department stores, supermarkets and general stores (-23.2% vs -24.3% in May), particularly for food, beverages or tobacco (-44% vs -45.4%).
Additionally, turnover declined further for other retail goods (-32.6% vs -31.1%), while growth softened for non-durable goods (2.5% vs 3.2%).
In contrast, revenues increased at a faster rate for durable goods (3% vs 2.7%), specially for sporting equipment (55% vs 52.2%), as well as motor vehicles and automotive fuel (7.7% vs 5.5%).
On a monthly basis, retail trade fell by 3.3% in June, following a downwardly revised 5.2% loss in the preceding period.

title: Thailand Retail Sales Fall for 3rd Month
